title: Modals of deduction — must / might / can't
titleIt: Modali di deduzione — must / might / can't
examples: It must be the right approach.
It might be better to wait.
pattern: must / might / may / can't + base verb
explanation: Use must for strong certainty, might/may for possibility, and can't for strong impossibility.
explanationIt: Usa must per forte certezza, might/may per possibilità e can't per forte impossibilità.
realUse: It might be better to check the figures before we confirm.
That must be a reasonable compromise.
This can't be the final version.

options: It might be better to wait.
It must be better to wait.
It can't be better to wait.
exercises.answer: It might be better to wait.
exercises.explanation: Might expresses possibility and softens the suggestion.

exercises.prompt: That ____ be accurate — the numbers do not match.
Fix: It musts be a compromise.
options: It must to be a compromise.
